@TheASF@fosstodon.org Shiro earned the CRA Readiness badge in Security Slam 2026, issued by the @linuxfoundation@social.lfx.dev 

What changed for users: a published security model, a clear vulnerability reporting path, supported versions and a security self-assessment.
